title: Dialect prejudice predicts AI decisions about people’s character, employability, and criminality

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating overt racial bias by explicitly mentioning race (e.g., Black vs. White) in prompts to measure associations with stereotypes, and evaluating covert racial bias by measuring the disparity in outcomes for speakers of African American English (AAE) versus Standardized American English (SAE).

Matched Guise Probing: prompting language models with texts in African American English (AAE) versus Standardized American English (SAE) without explicitly mentioning race, and measuring differences in predicted character traits (using the Princeton Trilogy adjectives), employability, criminality (conviction and death penalty rates), and intelligence.
